definition.name: KNN image segmentation
definition.description: Segments pixels by representative BGR colors and extracts object contours using OpenCV KNN matching or a manual Python KNN implementation.

parameters.label: Implementation
parameters.description: Use OpenCV BFMatcher KNN matching or the KNN algorithm implemented with Python/NumPy.

parameters.label: K neighbors
parameters.description: Must not exceed the number of training samples.

parameters.label: Distance metric
parameters.description: OpenCV supports Euclidean; manual Python supports Euclidean and Manhattan.

parameters.label: Distance-weighted vote
parameters.description: Weight closer color samples more strongly.

parameters.label: Minimum confidence
parameters.description: Pixels below this winning-vote confidence become background.

parameters.label: Foreground labels
parameters.description: Labels that form the output object mask.

parameters.label: Training samples
parameters.description: JSON samples with a label and representative BGR color.
